forbidden_paths_and_actions: original research overlays, market data, and business data
release directories, running services, schedulers, permissions, and hooks
training, backtests, new market data capture, BUY gates, production permissions, and orders
commit, push, deploy, service/task changes, or external actions

behavior_cases: R924/R955/R942 nested DATED state is preserved and visible as a weak review candidate; it is never promoted to current adopted support
top-level/nested conflicts are explicit, true missing values remain missing, and unknown enum values are pending rather than supported
the actual US_MAPPING entry invokes one backend aggregation and stable ordering; multiple source relations deduplicate by HK code while all positive and negative evidence remains expandable

ordering is current-supported, dated-weak, pending; within each group positive without negative, mixed positive/negative, negative, then flat/unknown; positive source return descending is a source-strength tie-break only; HK code resolves the final tie
ITA appears in available proxy coverage, and absent relation edges display mapping pending without constructing an edge
an invalid/wrong-session/pre-close quote cannot create direction and only degrades its own source relation
ordinary and post-holiday target sessions run from existing date/session/cutoff inputs without 2026-10-16 to 2026-10-20 gating
the frontend consumes backend candidate ordering and renders one default candidate table with date, source qualification, and visible risks; legacy summaries remain collapsed details
research safety remains RESEARCH_ONLY=true, production_allowed=false, buy_gate_updated=false, orders_sent=false
CLOSED_RESEARCH_SCOPE + CURRENT_RESEARCH_SCOPE 不能覆盖 catalog_research_use=EXCLUDED_CURRENT；关系保留明确排除原因，但不进入 catalog_candidates。
手工 quote 的 map symbol 与 quote.symbol 不一致、last/previous_close 缺失/非有限/非正，或 change_pct 与价格推导不符时，quote 不得 VERIFIED 或制造方向；影响仅限该关系，其他有效候选保留。
